pack_topic: How should research-os structure a research-pack so every research artifact becomes actionable implementation material for the repo?
pack_decision: Lock the schemas, gates, prompt contracts, and CLI surface for research-os v0.1 so the remaining workflow links can be built against a real spec instead of guesses.

sections.purpose: What research-os is, what it refuses to become, and what workflow must not be broken.
Exact folder structure, file schemas, required ledgers, receipts, and freeze outputs.
How source cards, claim extraction, citations, confidence, uncertainty, and unsupported claims work.
Hard gates, soft gates, waiver reasons, compensating controls, and failure states.
The real cowork-master.md contract, allowed actions, forbidden drift, synthesis responsibilities, and stop conditions.
How pack artifacts become searchable facts instead of dead markdown.
Commands, state transitions, status output, failure recovery, and section time budgeting.
Tests that prove the whole workflow exists and cannot regress into a partial report generator.
